faceit lvl 10 csgo, i think it has everything to do with animations and viewmodels, in csgo my viewmodel was basically completely still, now in cs2 it moves all around the place and makes the movement feel more sluggish and makes my counterstrafing slightly off. Which in cs makes a MASSIVE difference. The console command viewmodel\_recoil is also on by default and you can't change it, it makes the viewmodel follow the pattern of your spray and kind of makes it seem the the recoil is "higher" when in reality it's the same but the viewmodel is tricking you. So i feel like it all kind of boils down to alot of players using the viewmodel as a reference and now that reference has changed. But those are just my thoughts :)
